snippet.title: BACKYARD DERBY - DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description:
It's time to step up to the plate!

Introducing the newest game mode coming to Backyard Baseball this summer: Backyard Derby. Line up with Kenny, Kiesha, or Pablo and see how many home runs you can hit!

Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3935020/Backyard_Baseball/

Make sure you wishlist Backyard Baseball and check out all the exciting events we have this year at Backyardbaseball.com
